column1: # Lamakan confrontation: Ash Jenna's origin, her offer, and Isaac's response.

column3: You came back. I wondered\nif you would.{end_wait}
You watched us in the sand.\nYou knew what happened.\nWho are you?{end_wait}
You kept walking, so you\nhave earned an answer. I'll\ntell you what I am.{end_wait}
You aren't our Jenna. So\nwho are you?{end_wait}

I am a Jenna from a world
the Wise One destroyed.{page_break}I survived what he left.
I will not let him do it
to another world.{end_wait}
Then what do you want from\nus? From Isaac?{end_wait}

The beacons destroyed my
world. He will do it again.{page_break}I can help you stop him.
But you must decide whether
you trust me.{end_wait}
She believes what she's\nsaying, Isaac. But I don't\nthink she's told us all.{end_wait}
If she's telling the truth,\nwe need to know more.\nRevenge won't guide us.{end_wait}
You stayed with that miner\nuntil the end. I saw you.{end_wait}
Take her offer?{end_now}
All right. I'll help you\nmake him answer for what\nhe did.{end_wait}
Then stay close. The next\nbeacon will prove I was\nright.{end_wait}
Isaac, are you certain\nthis is the path we should\ntake?{end_wait}
Then I will see you at the\nnext lighthouse. Don't\nmake me wait.{end_wait}
No. We don't know enough\nto follow you. We'll find\nour own way.{end_wait}
Then keep walking. The\nWise One will not wait for\nyou to catch up.{end_wait}
We should keep moving,\nIsaac. We still have to\nreach Kalay.{end_wait}
Then we keep looking. I\nwon't pretend this is easy.\nBut the choice is ours.{end_wait}

Your Jenna, Kraden and
Felix are still Menardi's
prisoners.{page_break}The Wise One has noticed
you now, so hurry to Kalay.{end_wait}
